description: Verify a GYOTAK KOMON record directly from the Midnight blockchain. Reads on-chain state and returns the raw hex plus decoded fields for independent verification. Unlike get_komon_records (which returns GYOTAK's database), this reads directly from the chain. Shielded records prove region membership without exposing GPS. Currently preprod only.

komonId.description: Filter to a specific komon record by ID. Omit to return all records.

name: verify_komon
